method: Actual unmodified Fundamental plugin running in the Rack engine; Audio-2 hardware sink replaced with capture and its saved 10 Hz DC-filter recurrence. Original graph, module parameters and all 27 cables retained. Noise seed is freshly initialized.
post_processing: Constant gain to -3 dBFS raw peak; one-second linear fades at beginning and end. No EQ, compression, effects or timing edits.
